style: Painted 512x512, lit flat, palette matched to assets/art/wall_granite.png and floor_stone.png. Not pixel art.

wall_top.v1: wall_top_v1_mossy_coping_512.png — moss and lichen on granite capstones, overhead
wall_top.v2: wall_top_v2_broken_brick_512.png — crumbling cap, broken mortar, overhead
wall_top.note: First pair looked like wall faces (hanging drips); rejected in rejected/. These are the overhead redo. Top faces are not seen at eye height 0.82 vs walls 2.4; may need a skyline trim to be visible.

floor_wet.v1: floor_wet_v1_puddles_512.png — same 2x2 flagstones as floor_stone, puddles in joints and on slabs
floor_wet.v2: floor_wet_v2_flooded_512.png — wetter, more even standing water, cleaner joints
floor_wet.note: Replaces unused 256px floor_wet.png, which had baked lantern highlights. Leaves in the source were stamped out by hand.

floor_grate.spec: docs/art_needs.md P2 #13 drain grate, 512x512. Also a candidate to replace 32px exit.png if an exit tile is used.
floor_grate.v1: floor_grate_v1_square_iron_512.png — large rusted square grate, cobble rim
floor_grate.v2: floor_grate_v2_manhole_512.png — circular iron drain in flagstones
floor_grate.note: Hero tiles, not a repeating grate pattern. Shown in contact sheet surrounded by floor_stone. Surrounding stones are not the same 2x2 scale as floor_stone.
